race.comment: REMEMBER THE BOYS (11) is the horse to beat off a decisive win at this track, where he beat Red Feathers by just over three lengths after sitting just off the lead and kicking strongly. He was second here the start prior and can give this a shake. WARNA (4) has to be assessed on more than his last-start eighth, having been beaten just under two lengths at Gold Coast two back and now easing from provincial BM70 grade with a strong jockey record in his favour. Can feature. MISTING (3) was plain first-up at Doomben, but the move back from mid-week company, wet-track competence and the deeper G1 Queensland Oaks background keep her a threat. SETTAT (1) comes through Open grade at Mackay, where he was beaten just over half a length after jumping awkwardly, and his Class 4 win two back keeps him firmly in the each-way mix.
